Headline: Loop-bound Brown Line Service Delayed near Quincy
ShortDescription: Loop-bound Brown Line trains are standing near Quincy due to a mechanical problem. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Loop-bound Brown Line trains are standing near Quincy due to a mechanical problem.

Some Brown Line trains will be rerouted to the Inner Loop, please board/exit on the Green/Pink/Orange Line platforms. 

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

  • #29 State
  • #6 Jackson Park Express
  • #22 Clark

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
